matchups.recap: Rob got absolutely skull-fucked this week, losing by 30.4 points like he just grabbed his roster blindfolded and threw darts at a board of washed-up veterans. 72 points is what you score when your "studs" decide to collectively take a shit on the field, and apparently Rob's entire bench was either injured, suspended, or too busy being useless to show up. Rilind walked away from this massacre looking like a fantasy genius, but let's be honest—beating Rob this badly is like dunking on a 5th grader; the real question is why his team is so catastrophically bad that he makes it this easy.

Adam got absolutely obliterated 128.7 to 86.6, losing by a fucking 42-point margin—that's not a loss, that's a public execution. You managed to field a roster so catastrophically bad that Jetmir and Peter didn't even need their players to show up; they could've started a bunch of injured guys and still beat you by three scores. This wasn't a matchup, it was a mercy killing, and your team was the one getting put down like a lame horse.

Rinor got absolutely skull-fucked this week, losing by 40 points like he didn't even bother checking his lineup before kickoff. That's not a loss, that's a public execution—the kind of beatdown where you're down 40 and still have guys sitting on your bench who couldn't help anyway. Ilir walked into this matchup like a man possessed while Rinor showed up with what looked like a roster built from a waiver wire dumpster fire. Better luck next week, chief, because this week you got worked harder than a running back in the fourth quarter.

Faton just got absolutely demolished by his own flesh and blood, losing by 40.3 points like he showed up to Thanksgiving dinner with store-bought pie and a losing fantasy record. Flamur's gonna be hearing about this at every family gathering for the next year—Faton can't even beat his own blood without getting embarrassed in front of everybody. This is the kind of L that gets brought up at weddings, funerals, and random Sunday dinners forever. Faton's gonna have to sit at the kids' table next year after getting punked by a Muriqi.

Veton got absolutely shit-housed by 31.9 points this week, which is what happens when you field a roster that looks like it was assembled by someone who thinks "sleeper pick" means a player actively in a coma. Your team didn't just lose—it got mercy-ruled, and Arben was out here playing fantasy football while you were apparently playing fantasy *checkers*. Better luck next week, chief, but at this rate you'll need divine intervention and a waiver wire that includes players from the XFL.

Ben got absolutely obliterated this week by 78 fucking points—that's not a loss, that's a public execution. Scoring 87.6 points is what happens when you spend draft day drunk on confidence and sober on actual talent, and apparently your waiver wire strategy was "hope nobody notices I'm not paying attention." Nori didn't just beat you, Ben—he lapped you twice and took your lunch money on the way out. You're gonna need therapy, a new hobby, and maybe a fresh start in a league where everyone else forgot how to play football too.

matchups.preview: Rob's already 0-1 and somehow still thinks his squad can sniff the playoffs—buddy, you're about to be 0-2 after Adam reminds you why reaching for a tight end in round 4 was the dumbest shit you did all draft. Adam's not exactly lighting it up either, but at least he didn't build his team like he was playing madden with his eyes closed. One of you is about to be swimming in the basement where you both belong.

Rinor's already down 0-1 and now has to watch his family member sit pretty at 1-0—yeah, this is the week Mom stops asking how your season's going and just starts asking why Rilind's doing better. One of you is about to get absolutely humiliated in front of the family group chat, and Rinor, you're limping in desperate while Rilind's got that "I told you so" energy already locked and loaded. Better pray your waiver wire saves you, because holiday dinners are about to get real awkward.

Flamur's sitting pretty at 1-0, but we all know that's just the appetizer before he serves up his usual mid-season collapse—this dude's gonna choke harder than he did in Week 8 last year when his entire roster forgot how to score. Jetmir and Peter are rolling in thinking they've got something special, but history doesn't lie: one of these bastards always finds a creative new way to fumble away a win they had no business losing. This week, somebody's perfect record gets flushed, and honestly, it could go either way because both these teams are just one bad waiver-wire decision away from complete implosion.

Both of you are sitting pretty at 1-0, but let's be honest—one win doesn't mean shit when you're about to face each other and remember how to lose. Arben's probably got the softest schedule win imaginable, and Ilir's riding high on dumb luck, so whoever chokes first this week gets the privilege of remembering what it feels like to be back where you belong: struggling.

Nori's sitting pretty at 1-0 but let's be real—that win came against someone who probably auto-drafted their entire bench. Faton's already staring down an 0-2 hole after getting cute with his Week 1 lineup, and nothing says "I'm about to get embarrassed again" like walking into this matchup with the confidence of someone who learned nothing. This should be a bloodbath.

Ben's already scraping the bottom of the barrel at 0-1, and now he's about to get a masterclass in how to actually tank with *purpose* when he faces Veton this week. Two teams that can't win a fucking game between them, but at least Veton's got the excuse of being new to this—Ben's just been making actively terrible decisions all season and watching his season implode in real time. One of you assholes is going 0-2, and honestly, Ben's got more experience at it.
